comment: POSTGAME.md P4b, Thistlewick and the pension. The morning after the ending: the letter on the mat, walked onto and read - clause nineteen, Friday, the pension once and the key; Mother before and after it, and NIX-4's pie dish still owed under her post-game page; the Old Man (short, not in on the coast) with his chair still owed; the child, the notice board and the dog man, each after their first page; Elder Wispel; the forty-eighth frame and the Wall walked to, the minute book's SEE BRAM; the Regular; Nether Sopping's front door, NIX-3's pot still owed at it, then the key into Ambrose Fitch's cottage - the bed for nothing, his chair, the pot watered, Mrs Pimm's note, one cup, and out; and Ysolde's line about the pot, after her tale and the bench.

steps.eval: window._lines = []; const add = Game_Message.prototype.add; Game_Message.prototype.add = function (t) { window._lines.push(t); return add.call(this, t); }; window._mark = () => { window._tropes = $gameVariables.value(2); window._gold = $gameParty.gold(); window._lines = []; }; window._mark(); window._has = s => window._lines.some(l => l.includes(s)); window._pick = undefined; const sc = Game_Message.prototype.setChoices; Game_Message.prototype.setChoices = function (c, d, k) { return sc.call(this, c, window._pick === undefined ? d : window._pick, k); }

steps.label: before the ending: no letter on the mat
and Mother is on her first page
the morning after: the letter is on the mat, and Mother has a page on top of NIX-4's

steps.check: [window._has("There's a letter come."), window._has("I ironed it Tuesday.")]
steps.label: Mother, before it is read: there's a letter come
walked onto the mat
the action button on the mat reads the letter

steps.check: [window._has('CLAUSE NINETEEN'), window._has('We trust Friday will suit.'), window._has('There is no mention of the next one.'), $gameParty.gold() - window._gold, $gameParty.hasItem($dataItems[76])]
steps.label: the letter: clause nineteen, Friday, the pension paid once, and the key
the letter is off the mat

steps.check: [window._has('A cottage! By the sea!'), window._has('I ironed it Tuesday.')]
steps.label: Mother, after it: a cottage by the sea, and the good shirt
with Nix and the goods, the post-game page still wins
and plays NIX-4's pie dish, which is still owed, instead of itself

steps.check: [window._has('A cottage! By the sea!'), window._has('One pie dish.')]
steps.label: once returned, Mother is back on the coast
still on the map

steps.check: [window._has('You came back.'), window._has('Good lad. That') , window._has('Forty-seven was my boy.')]
steps.label: the Old Man: you came back, and nothing about the coast
the Old Man is not in on the coast
the Old Man's chair is still owed, and plays
and then he is glad to see you
the child's first page is still owed: the dungeon, first
then the seaside, at volume
the notice board's first reading is still owed
then the farewell tea, Friday

steps.check: [window._has('the coast is very windy'), window._has('The dog has not made a sound.')]
steps.label: the dog says take a coat to the coast
still on the map

steps.check: [window._has('Back!'), window._has('Renewable. What a lovely hand.'), window._has("You'll have had the letter."), window._has('Sea air, Bram.')]
steps.label: Elder Wispel: the hero back, the Receipt, the letter, sea air
walked up under the forty-seventh: the forty-eighth frame answers

steps.check: [window._has('PORTRAIT TO FOLLOW. SITTER AT THE COAST.'), window._has("The Quills' card")]
steps.label: an empty frame, and the card
with PIP-1 settled, the Quills' card is in the corner of it
the Wall of the Forty-Seven, from under its first portrait
the Wall, word for word
the minute book on the east table, from below
the minute book: SEE BRAM, and clause nineteen
still on the map
the Regular: lovely coast, apparently
with Nix and Lorrimer's list, the pot is still owed at the door, and plays first
the key opens it: Ambrose Fitch's cottage
the bed, from its foot

steps.check: [$gameActors.actor(1).hp === $gameActors.actor(1).mhp, $gameParty.gold() === window._gold, window._has('You can hear the sea.')]
steps.label: a night in it, for nothing
his chair, from behind it

steps.check: [window._has('turned to face the window'), window._has("You don't either."), $gameMap.event(3).characterName()]
steps.label: Fitch's chair, facing the window
the pot under the sill

steps.check: [window._has('a dead thing in it'), window._has('It goes on being dead, but it has')]
steps.label: watered; nothing grows
the note on the table

steps.check: [window._has('AIRED TUESDAYS. KETTLE IN THE CUPBOARD.'), window._has('THE OTHER KEY')]
steps.label: Mrs Pimm's note
the cupboard
one cup
out of the front door, onto the step

steps.check: [window._has('Ysolde Marrow. I kept'), window._has('water that thing')]
steps.label: never met: her tale is still owed, and comes first

steps.check: [window._has('Ambrose Fitch. The Forty-Fourth.'), window._has('water that thing in the pot?'), window._has('It was dead when he bought it.')]
steps.label: then her usual line, and the pot

steps.check: [window._has("You've been out to the mound."), window._has('water that thing')]
steps.label: the bench is still owed, and plays instead

steps.check: [window._has('Mind that kit.'), window._has('water that thing in the pot?')]
steps.label: then her last page, and the pot
still on the map
